checks.command: sh -c 'resolve() { f="$1"; d=$(dirname "$f"); while [ "$d" != "." ] && [ "$d" != "/" ]; do case "$d" in packages/*/*/*|examples/*/*/*) : ;; packages/*/*|examples/*/*|packages/*|examples/*) [ -f "$d/tsconfig.json" ] && { echo "$d"; return; } ;; esac; d=$(dirname "$d"); done; }; files=$({ git diff --name-only HEAD -- packages examples; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- packages examples; } 2>/dev/null); dirs=$(for f in $files; do resolve "$f"; done | sort -u); status=0; for d in $dirs; do if [ -f "$d/package.json" ] && grep -q "\"typecheck\"" "$d/package.json"; then if grep -q "packages/tooling/tsc/dist/bin.cjs" "$d/package.json" && [ ! -f packages/tooling/tsc/dist/bin.cjs ]; then ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p "$d" || true; else (cd "$d" && bun run typecheck) || status=1; fi; else ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p "$d" || status=1; fi; done; exit $status'
